svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pan 490 x 430 x 25 deep from 1 mm sheet: blank 540 x 480 with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre cut out to leave an 8 mm rim (inner 474 x 414). Fold the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four sides up 25 at the 490 x 430 lines; the rim becomes an inward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom lip. Notch and rivet the corners; seal them with silicone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 1 mm perforated aluminium (about 50 % open), 488 x 428, laid

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the lip, with a stainless woven mesh (1 mm aperture) of the same

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: size on top. The sorbent holds them down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the inside and the top edge matt black (high-temperature);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: EPDM gasket tape under the lip, all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lip sits on the baffle gasket over its opening; 13 to 23 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the walls, 14 mm between trays.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the floor sags less than 3 mm with 1 kg spread on it.
